declarations.description:
Edits how something repeats, as the custom recurrence dialogs of Google Calendar and Outlook do: "Repeat weekly,
every 2 weeks, on Monday and Wednesday, ends after 10 occurrences". A sentence sums the rule up and the next
occurrences show under it.

`value` is an RFC 5545 RRULE (`FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=MO,WE;COUNT=10`) by default, or a five-field cron
expression with `format="cron"` (`30 9 * * 1-5`), the schedule of a job. In cron format the editor offers only what
cron can say: a time of day, steps that divide their range, no end and no "third Tuesday". The same rule is always
available in both through `toRRule()` and `cron`.

`start` is the first occurrence (the event's DTSTART): it seeds the weekday, the day of the month and the month when
the frequency changes, and the next occurrences count from it (today when it is not set). `frequencies` lists the
frequencies offered; add `none` to offer "Does not repeat", which is an empty value. An empty value without `none`
shows, and takes, a weekly rule on the start's weekday.

It is a form control: under a `name` the form receives the value, and `required` asks for a rule other than "Does
not repeat". `parseRRule`, `formatRRule`, `parseCron`, `formatCron`, `occurrences` and `describeRecurrence` are
exported for tables and servers.

members.name: value
members.description: The rule, in `format`: an RRULE (`FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE`, an `RRULE:` prefix is read too) or a cron expression. Empty for "Does not repeat".

members.name: format
members.description: What `value` holds: `rrule` (the default) or `cron`.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name. The form receives `value`.

members.name: start
members.description: The first occurrence, `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` (DTSTART). Today when empty.

members.name: frequencies
members.description:
The frequencies offered, separated by spaces: `none` (Does not repeat), `minutely`, `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`,
`monthly`, `yearly`. Defaults to `daily weekly monthly yearly`, and to every frequency but `none` in cron format.

members.name: weekStart
members.description:
The first day of the week in the weekday row, `MO` (the default) to `SU`, and the `WKST` a new weekly rule takes
("every 2 weeks" counts weeks from that day). A rule read from `value` keeps its own `WKST`.

members.name: withTime
members.description: Shows a time-of-day row, written as `BYHOUR`/`BYMINUTE`. Always shown in cron format.

members.name: previewCount
members.description: How many of the next occurrences to show. `0` hides them.

members.name: required
members.description: Asks for a rule other than "Does not repeat" before the form can be submitted.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents interaction and excludes the value from form submission.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the editor's group. Defaults to the enclosing field's label, then to "Recurrence".

members.name: renderOccurrence
members.description: Draws each of the next occurrences instead of the built-in date text.

members.name: model
members.description: The rule shown; `null` is "Does not repeat".

members.name: readValue
members.description: The value the model was last read from or written to, so an outside change to `value` is read again.

members.name: rule
members.description: The rule as an object, `null` for "Does not repeat". Setting it writes `value` in `format`.

members.name: summary
members.description: The rule as a sentence, in the element's language: "Every 2 weeks on Monday and Wednesday, 10 times".

members.name: cron
members.description: The rule as a cron expression, or `null` when cron cannot say it (an end, "the third Tuesday", every 2 weeks).

members.name: toRRule
members.description: The rule as an RRULE value (no `RRULE:` prefix), or `''` for "Does not repeat".

members.name: nextOccurrences
members.description: The next `limit` occurrences from `start`, as local dates.

members.name: upcoming
members.description:
The occurrences from `start`. A cron step counts from the top of its range (minute 0, midnight, January), not from
the start, so in cron format the steps are laid out from there and the ones before `start` skipped.

members.name: offered
members.description: The frequencies offered, with the shown one added when `frequencies` leaves it out (unless `listedOnly`).

members.name: timeFromStart
members.description: The time of day `start` names, when it has one.

members.name: syncModel
members.description: Reads `value` again when it changed from outside.

members.name: commit
members.description: Applies an edit, writes `value` and tells the app.

members.name: renderSelect
members.description: A c2-select of `options`, firing `pick` with the chosen value.

members.name: renderNumber
members.description: A c2-number-input between `min` and `max`, firing `set` with each whole number typed.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired after the user changes the rule, once `value` holds it; also while typing a number.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the user changes the rule, once `value` holds it.
